channel.title: Public Preview on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Public Preview on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: github: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
item.description:
GitHub added a public preview REST API for enabling or disabling code scanning’s AI Scan at both the organization and repository levels. The feature introduces a new repository_scan setting.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation with Azure Front Door Auth Policy
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium now supports JWT validation in public preview through the Front Door Auth Policy. It validates Microsoft Entra ID bearer tokens at the edge before traffic reaches APIs or web applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Auto scaling of ingestion limits in Azure Monitor workspace
item.description:
Azure Monitor Workspace now has a public preview feature for auto scaling ingestion limits per workspace. When enabled, the service adjusts the quota ceiling automatically based on observed usage patterns to help maintain healthy ingestion.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance. It is intended to replace custom scripts and disconnected tools for monitoring business-critical workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Rate limit grouping for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium WAF now supports rate limit grouping in public preview. This lets rate limit rules aggregate requests across a group instead of counting only per client IP, which helps with distributed attacks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Distributed accelerator for cloud storage on AKS
item.description:
Distributed accelerator for cloud storage (DACS) is now in public preview for AI workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). It runs as a distributed read-through cache within the cluster and uses local NVMe disks across nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door adds native gRPC support
item.description:
Azure Front Door Standard and Premium now have public preview support for gRPC. The feature lets you route requests to specific services and methods and distribute traffic for gRPC applications through Front Door.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Public Preview: Azure Route Server dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 support
item.description:
Azure Route Server now supports IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack mode in public preview. It enables route exchange for both address families over supported hybrid networking connections, while existing IPv4 connections remain unchanged.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Modernize Arc-enabled Windows Servers with Azure File Sync
item.description:
Azure File Sync for Arc-enabled Windows Servers is now in preview. The update adds a guided Azure portal experience to help modernize servers and move or sync data with Azure Files while keeping the local file server model.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Secret scanning detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs
item.description:
GitHub secret scanning now detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs. The feature is available in public preview and adds workflow logs to the existing scanning coverage for issues, wikis, discussions, and pull requests.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New pull request overview page in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has introduced a new pull request overview page in public preview. It is intended to make it easier to see what is blocking a long pull request without scrolling through extensive comments and timeline events.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant as a public preview. The integration lets users access Copilot directly within the native Xcode workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall IPv6 now supports application rules
item.description:
Azure Firewall IPv6 is now in public preview for application rules, adding layer 7 filtering for IPv6 HTTP and HTTPS traffic. This extends application-level controls to IPv6 and dual-stack deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-disk crash-consistent VM restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks on VMs with SCSI disk controller
item.description:
Azure VM public preview adds multi-disk crash-consistent restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks on VMs using SCSI disk controllers. It supports agent-less capture of crash-consistent restore points.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports centralized JWT validation in public preview through the AuthPolicy custom resource. It can validate token signature, issuer, lifetime, and configured audience using signing keys from a trusted HTTP source.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MCP gateway for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) routing in preview via a new MCPRoute custom resource. This lets platform teams expose MCP servers behind a stable hostname and path while centralizing TLS and JWT validation through Web Application Firewall features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Private ingress for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports private frontends in public preview. These frontends are reachable only through approved Azure Private Link private endpoints, keeping internal, shared, and cross-cluster traffic on private networking.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced capacity insights are now available in Azure Storage Discovery
item.description:
Azure Storage Discovery is adding advanced capacity insights in public preview. The update expands visibility into storage usage with insights such as access patterns, data age, storage tiers, object size distribution, and retention-related data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Extend immutability for PITR backups for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance now support extending immutability for PITR backups in public preview. This lets you lock backup retention to the configured PITR retention period instead of only the default 7 days.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: On-prem NAS share discovery and assessment are now available using Azure Migrate
item.description:
Azure Migrate added public preview support for discovering and assessing on-premises NAS shares. The feature helps plan migrations of Dell PowerScale (OneFS) and NetApp ONTAP storage to Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Support database-level managed identity (including FIC) in Create Database Scoped Credential T-SQL
item.description:
Azure SQL Database public preview adds database-level managed identity support, including federated identity credentials (FIC), for creating database scoped credentials in T-SQL. This lets each database use a user-assigned managed identity to access Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 via external tables and OPENROWSET.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Cross Tenant Restore with Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports Cross-Tenant Restore in public preview, allowing Azure VM backups to be restored into a separate Azure tenant. This provides an independent recovery path using the existing backup copy, without needing custom backup infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Security extension for the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
A new GitHub security extension is available in public preview for the GitHub Copilot app. It lets you review and work through repository code scanning alerts without leaving the app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot supports server-to-server authentication
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, in public preview. This lets services and agents built with the GitHub Copilot SDK make authenticated requests on behalf of an app without user-based auth.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Public monitoring now available with data residency
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency now supports public monitoring in public preview. This extends secret scanning beyond internal repositories to monitor public content.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens
item.description:
GitHub CLI now offers a public preview of expiring OAuth credentials that automatically refresh. When enabled, gh stores an expiring access token and uses refresh flow to keep it valid.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Disable VNet peering route
item.description:
Azure announced public preview of Disable VNet Peering Route (DPR), a route-table capability that suppresses system-generated peering routes on subnets associated with the route table. This gives more control over traffic flow between peered virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub package firewall in public preview
item.description:
GitHub package firewall is now in public preview. It is intended to reduce malware risks during package installation by blocking package-install-time attacks that can steal credentials from CI/CD hosts or developer workstations.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Databricks Private network gateway
item.description:
Azure Databricks Private network gateway is now in Public Preview. It lets serverless compute reach resources in your VNet and transitively connected networks through a single managed gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Files cross-region data copy and synchronization with Azure Storage Mover
item.description:
Azure Files now supports copying and synchronizing file share data across storage accounts, Azure regions, and subscriptions within the same tenant using Azure Storage Mover. The feature is in public preview and supports scheduled incremental transfers to maintain secondary copies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are now in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, Team, and Free plans. They let workflows pin dependencies more reliably even if tags or branches later move.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Push attribution for commits in limited public preview
item.description:
GitHub now records the authenticated user who pushed each commit and exposes that pusher identity in the UI and API. This is in limited public preview and is available alongside the existing author and committer fields.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management is now in public preview. The integration connects centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AKS on bare metal now on Ubuntu
item.description:
Azure has a public preview for running AKS on bare metal using Ubuntu, aimed at on-premises Kubernetes deployments without a virtualization layer. The update highlights support for local control of hardware and software, with a focus on AI workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB expands to additional regions
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now available in additional Azure regions in public preview. The expansion gives users more deployment options for PostgreSQL workloads closer to applications and users.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 Support for Application Gateway WAF
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway WAF now supports inspection and enforcement for IPv6 traffic in Public Preview. This adds IPv6 support to the web application firewall layer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Major version upgrades (MVU) for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support major version upgrades in public preview. Existing clusters can be upgraded in place to a newer supported PostgreSQL version without creating a replacement cluster or migrating distributed data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Repository security advisory comments API in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has added REST API support for reading, adding, and editing comments on repository security advisories. The API also works for advisories created from private vulnerability reports.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use
item.description:
GitHub Copilot computer use is now in public preview in Copilot CLI and the Copilot app on macOS and Windows. It can interact with desktop applications on the user’s behalf.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines. It lets you monitor SQL Server on Azure VMs without creating custom collection scripts or manually correlating telemetry.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ubuntu 26.04 support in AKS
item.description:
AKS now has public preview support for Ubuntu 26.04 node pools through a new Ubuntu2604 OS SKU based on Ubuntu Minimal. The update is intended to help teams move with Ubuntu LTS releases while addressing package footprint, security, and compatibility concerns.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Azure has introduced a public preview of Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets. Azure will automatically choose suitable availability zones based on SKU availability, capacity, and placement requirements, reducing the need to manage zone lists manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Ultra Disk
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server now supports Ultra Disk in public preview. It is intended for I/O-intensive, transaction-heavy workloads that need consistently low latency.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Performance Monitoring for Azure SQL Database
item.description:
Microsoft has opened public preview of managed SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Database. It provides built-in monitoring so you do not need custom data collection scripts or manual correlation across separate tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public preview: Script-based deployment for SQL Server on Linux Azure VM
item.description:
Public preview of a script-based deployment flow for SQL Server on Linux Azure VMs. It replaces legacy marketplace images with automated provisioning and adds more flexibility and customization.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Late-September 2026 Azure SQL preview updates include Database Hub in Microsoft Fabric. The hub provides a unified experience for discovering, managing, monitoring, and optimizing databases across SQL Server and Azure SQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Serverless auto-pause and auto-resume
item.description:
Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Serverless now supports auto-pause and auto-resume in public preview. Databases can pause during inactivity and resume automatically when activity returns.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate directly from Azure Arc to Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale
item.description:
Azure Arc database migration now supports Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale, as a direct migration target in public preview. The guided workflow also handles Azure Database Migration Service and Self-hosted Integration Runtime setup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft SQL Agent Skills
item.description:
Microsoft SQL Agent Skills are in public preview. They provide product-specific guidance for AI agents used to build, operate, and migrate SQL workloads across Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Database container, and SQL Server migration scenarios.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Long-term retention (LTR) v2 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
LTR v2 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL is in public preview. It replaces LTR v1’s logical pg_dump/pg_restore backups with physical snapshot-based backups integrated with Azure Backup Vaults.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview : Microsoft entra kerberos authentication for Azure NetApp Files
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files now supports Microsoft Entra Kerberos authentication for SMB volumes in public preview. It allows hybrid and cloud-only users to authenticate via Microsoft Entra ID using cloud-issued Kerberos tickets.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Dev Hub
item.description:
Azure SQL Dev Hub is in public preview as a central starting point for building applications with Azure SQL. It provides guidance for connecting from .NET, Python, Node.js, and Java, and supports development workflows including AI agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB supports PostgreSQL 18
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now in public preview with PostgreSQL 18 support. The service is a fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible cloud-native database for scalable, high-performance workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Flex Nodes for AKS
item.description:
Flex Nodes for AKS is now in public preview. It lets application and platform teams use hybrid and edge infrastructure as connected worker nodes to an AKS control plane in Azure, while keeping a consistent Kubernetes control plane.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Foundry Routines in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Foundry Agent Service now includes Foundry Routines in public preview. This adds a native trigger primitive so published agents can run automatically on schedules or in response to business events.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Mdsv4 and Msv4 Series Virtual Machines for SAP
item.description:
Azure announced public preview availability of the Mdsv4 and Msv4 memory-optimized virtual machine series for SAP. The series uses 6th Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and includes advanced security features plus Azure Boost technologies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry public preview now supports network egress controls for hosted agents. Customers can define ordered outbound rules by destination host, including wildcard FQDNs like *.contoso.com, with allow or deny actions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Payments HSM v2
item.description:
Azure Payments HSM v2 is in public preview. It is a highly available, single-tenant payment HSM service for payment processing, credential issuance, PIN processing, key management, and authentication data protection, with exclusive administrative control retained by the customer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added a public preview for soft delete on logical servers. When a logical server is deleted, it enters a soft-deleted state and can be restored within the configured window.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes
item.description:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes is now in public preview. This deployment option separates the OpenShift control plane into a fully managed service from the worker nodes that run customer workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Microsoft previewed PostgreSQL skills and an MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The plugin is intended to make supported AI coding assistants context-aware for PostgreSQL and able to provide guidance and perform actions on a connected database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot suggests custom properties definitions
item.description:
GitHub Copilot can now suggest allowed values when creating custom properties for repositories in an organization. The feature is in public preview for GitHub Copilot Business and Copilot users.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: HTTP/3 over QUIC support in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now has public preview support for HTTP/3 over QUIC. The update is intended to improve connection setup time, reduce latency, and increase resiliency for web applications and APIs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB)
item.description:
Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB) in public preview. The migration can move data from Windows Server or NAS shares without deploying, registering, or maintaining a migration agent.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Refreshed repository pull requests page in public preview
item.description:
GitHub is previewing a refreshed repository-level pull request listing page for all users. The update adds stronger filtering and a compact presentation mode.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI Scan for pull request APIs in public preview
item.description:
GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for pull request feature can now be enabled and managed via REST API at both the organization and repository levels. The APIs are in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
item.description:
GitHub’s Xcode 27 runner image for GitHub-hosted macOS runners now runs on macOS 27 and is available in public preview. This lets you validate Apple apps against macOS 27 using that runner image.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
item.description:
Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF) now supports associating WAF policies at the profile and route levels in public preview. This lets you apply baseline protection across a profile and more targeted policies on specific routes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Reader Endpoint for Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server now has a public preview of a reader endpoint to simplify connection management when using multiple replicas. The endpoint provides automatic load balancing for read-only connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Per-disk resiliency for Azure VMs
item.description:
Azure VMs now have a public preview option for per-disk resiliency. By default, Azure still recovers a VM by shutting it down and powering it back on after managed disk connectivity is restored.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: aks: AppNet 2026-08-19
item.description:
AppNet 2026-08-19 adds public preview availability in more Azure regions, retires AppNet 1.0–1.2, and updates supported versions to Istio 1.28.10, 1.29.6, and new AppNet 1.5 on Istio 1.30.3. The release also includes fixes for cluster validation, gateway CRD conflicts, certificate rotation, multicluster traffic, identity-based updates, cleanup on delete/leave, diagnostics, and clearer error reporting.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 dual-stack support for Azure Bastion
item.description:
Azure Bastion now supports IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack configurations in public preview. New Bastion deployments can be configured with both IPv4 and IPv6 public IP addresses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Introducing Live Reports for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Live Reports are now in Public Preview for Azure SRE Agent. They let operations teams create dynamic operational views from SRE Agent conversations and keep them updated with the latest data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Push rules in rulesets now support path exceptions
item.description:
Push rules in GitHub rulesets now support path exceptions, letting you exempt specific file paths so a rule applies everywhere else in scope. The feature is available in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
item.description:
GitHub’s Slack integration now includes agentic GitHub Copilot capabilities from Copilot CLI and the Copilot app, available in public preview. Users can interact with @GitHub in Slack to work with these features.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Formatter in MSSQL extension
item.description:
The MSSQL extension now includes SQL Formatter in public preview, letting you format SQL scripts directly in the editor. It adds customizable formatting options to align scripts with a preferred coding style.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ipv6 support in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall is now in public preview with IPv6 support. Customers can configure Azure Firewall and Firewall Policy in dual-stack mode for IPv4 and IPv6 traffic, including native IPv6 network-rule filtering and DNS Proxy support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Zone redundancy for Azure SQL Managed Instance Next-gen General Purpose
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance Next-gen General Purpose now supports public preview of zone redundancy. It automatically distributes compute and data across availability zones to improve resilience and business continuity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Linux on WSL
item.description:
Azure Linux on WSL is available in Public Preview (Beta). It lets teams run Azure Linux on developer workstations to validate production-aligned behavior, reproduce issues more reliably, and reduce debugging time.

  • Source: Azure Updates
